lines.en:
Why are they making us leave?
They said the bad people are coming to take us away from our home.  They said they are non believers.
Yeah, this one prolly told 'em we are here.  We all know he's not a believer like us, he doesn't even want to give up his old name.  Isn't that right, ALEX?!
Shut up!  I didn't tell anyone!!
lines.zh: 闭嘴！ 我没有跟任何人说！

lines.en: Stupid Alex... we're gonna tell on you.
lines.zh: 愚蠢的艾利克斯……我们要告发你。

lines.en: Listen! My mom's gonna kill the masters.  You'll see.  She's the best fighter in the world.  Then you can have your real families back!!
lines.zh: 听着！我妈妈会干掉大师们的。 你等着瞧吧。 她是世界最强的战士。 然后你就可以和你真正的家人团聚了！！

lines.en:
That's it, you're dead.  Come on, let's tell the masters we have a sacrifice!!!
Ha ha ha ha...  Yeah! Get the non believer!!!
Alright you little freaks, keep it down in here.  The Emperor is coming.
Hello, young man.  Your name is Alex, yes?  Don't worry, you can say it here.
lines.zh: 你好，小家伙。 你的名字是艾利克斯，对吧？ 没关系，在这儿你可以把它念出来。
lines.name: 卡西米尔

lines.en: Are the other children bothering you?
lines.zh: 其他孩子们有打扰到你吗？
lines.name: 卡西米尔

lines.en: Ha ha... not a tattle-tale, I see.  Alex, I'm going to take you to a safe place.  Please come with me.
lines.zh: 哈哈……你不是那种会告密的人，朕明白了。 艾利克斯，朕会把你带到一个安全的地方。 跟朕来。
lines.name: 卡西米尔

lines.en: Do you know where my mom is??
lines.zh: 你知道我妈妈在哪儿吗？

lines.en: ...  I am sorry, I cannot say I know her.  But, I am the Emperor - so I should be able to find her, don't you think?
lines.zh: …… 很抱歉，朕并不认识她。 然而，朕是皇帝——所以朕应当能够找到她，你不觉得吗？
lines.name: 卡西米尔

lines.en: The rest of you, follow the masters' instructions.  The...  non-believers are coming to get you.
lines.zh: 你们其他人，遵从大师们的指示。 那些…… 无信者过来抓你们了。
lines.name: 卡西米尔

lines.en: Let's get out of this den of muck...
lines.zh: 让我们先离开这鬼地方吧……
lines.name: 卡西米尔
